tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: CA certified Annual Turnover of Rs 50 Lakhs in last three financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25

Bidder Should inspect to the location and submit the report along with the technical bid with in one week from the date of publish and upload the documents in e-procurement portal.
CA certified Annual Turnover of Rs 50 Lakhs in last three financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Firm/bidders blacklisted at any stage or by any Central Universities/Central/State Government body/PSUs etc. need not to apply. Affidavit to be submitted

If tenderer is Original Equipment Manufacturer OEM of Computers/ Copier Machines should have at least 3 years of experience / expertise in the successful execution of similar works tendered and the cost of such any one work should not be less than Fifty Lakhs amount in a single order in any State Governments or Central Government Department or Undertaking /Universities

If tenderer is quoting as an authorized reseller / Channel partner of an OEM at least 3 years of experience / expertise in the successful Maintenance of IT products and the cost of such any one work should not be less than Fifty Lakhs in a single order in any State Central Governments or Central Government Department or Undertaking /Universities
